name: Nakokoi!
source:
The main character (Ken/Big Brother) is a student who is going abroad… which leads him to
indulge in a forbidden incestuous relationship with his little sister (Nako).
Story 2: Big brother is tempted by the unbelievable body of his apartment manager's young wife, Aya.
These 2 stories will light up what's left of the summer!

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE034192.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
男主角健，也就是「哥哥」，是一名即将出国留学的学生……这令他与妹妹鸣恋陷入禁忌的乱伦关系。
故事2：哥哥受到公寓管理员年轻妻子绫那令人难以置信的身材诱惑。
这两段故事将点亮夏日最后的时光！

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE034192.html]DLsite English[/url]]
